Match Report

A high energy performance by the entire team. With 2 subs, the players kept their foot on the gas. Up 3-0 at half time and never let up ending with a commanding 10-0 win. Each individual is growing in confidence with each game. Fantastic to see the additional cheer squads from families and friends.

What Went Well

The team's pace and pressure to win the ball and getting stuck into tackles, even at the cost of some bumps, bruises and tumbles. Discipline of team's structure, especially from our defence and keeper when there was little action.

Improvements

Passing can still be improved, looking for our teammates in space.
